description: Numeric palette and color-index facts from the original Amiga release. No original images, audio, executable code, or compressed resources are included.
color_encoding: ECS 12-bit RGB words, 0xRGB; original resource words are big-endian.
menu_mapping_method: Pair DOS and Amiga decoded pixels at identical local coordinates within same-named, same-size bitmap chunks. Preserve counts, use largest count, lowest index wins ties.
menu_mapping_fallback: For unobserved DOS indices, nearest normalized RGB squared distance to ECS profile palette; compare RGB6*15 against RGB4*63, lowest index wins ties. Observed majority values always take precedence.
menu_mapping_limitations: Majority mapping is not lossless: some DOS indices correspond to multiple original Amiga indices. Fullscreen UI overlays and other resources can need separate treatment. No runtime scene API is assumed.
dashboard_mapping_method: Same-named visible DOS/Amiga STDA and STDB bitmaps at equal local coordinates, equal positions/heights; ignore only right-side16-pixel alignment padding in original Amiga bitmap. Original indices restricted0..15.
dashboard_mapping_limitations: Majority correspondence is descriptive, not lossless. A car-wide map merges all compared chunks, so an index can have conflicting instrument/dashboard mappings. Raw transparent pixels are included, masks excluded. No original runtime palette application is inferred from this table.

scene_palette_provenance.address_convention: All code addresses are offsets within CODE hunk; add40 for original file offset. A4=DATA+32766.

palette_apply.behavior: Copies palette words from stack argument+8 into render-window palette record+0x98, colors at record+0x0a, for both render lists.

scenes.identification: Loads misc, gstu, gver and mop text resources in same function0x535c..0x5576.

scenes.confidence: inherited static caller-state, not independently applied in editor
scenes.editor: CODE0x1b6d4 loads SDTEDIT at0x1b6d8..0x1b6e4; no direct palette-apply calls A4-0x7a34 in code0x1b6d4..0x1d438; SDTEDIT contains no palette chunk.

limitations: Static call-path analysis, not a live original-Amiga emulator palette trace.
Full recursive helper-call proof was not attempted; known editor callers and direct palette writes were inspected.
